z_ai_generation_completed_trigger.description: Runs each time a generation is completed in Z.ai. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields model, task_status, video_result, request_id, image_result

z_ai_generation_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time a generation is failed in Z.ai. Ones failed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields model, task_status, video_result, request_id, image_result
